messages.content: Are there any penalties for prepayment?

Prepayment means repaying some or all of a loan principal before the scheduled maturity date. Whether a prepayment charge applies depends on the loan product, repayment structure, applicable customer category, and prevailing policy. Customers should verify the applicable prepayment terms before making a large early repayment because charges and eligibility conditions can differ between products.
